challenge_tests.background: Development white 4x fold checks black-to-white transfer with magnification shift mixed in; no isolated full-background final test
challenge_tests.capture_session: Capture dates are class-confounded; descriptive date counts only
challenge_tests.magnification: Three development condition-transfer folds; final test is held-out white Micro combination, not pure magnification transfer. Four conflicting white 4x tags retained by folder membership; omit from magnification-specific summaries only, retain all main fold scores.
challenge_tests.shortcut_controls: Phase 4 metadata-only and background-only models use the same development folds

evaluation_group_rule: Class/background/folder condition blocks; preparation units are separate and derived from user confirmation plus reviewed scenes
holdout_access: All images visually audited in Phase 1. No model fitting, processing design or scoring preceded this revision. White 4x is now development; white Micro remains held out. Do not use white Micro for mask review, feature design, tuning, training, calibration or model selection. Score locked winner once in Phase 6; later reuse is exploratory.
leakage_rules: Fit scalers, PCA, feature selectors, learned preprocessing and class weights on each training fold only
Split before tiles/crops/augmentation; descendants inherit source membership; aggregate tiles to one image prediction
Known same-scene views share one preparation unit and evaluation block
No date, filename, path, EXIF or background tags as inputs to the visual classifier
Do not calibrate probabilities or claim verified confidence without independent calibration data
membership_rule: white Micro -> final holdout (134); black 4x, black Micro, white 4x -> development (414); no random photograph split

metrics.balanced_accuracy: Mean class recall; undefined when any true class missing
metrics.binary: Map seven-class argmax to 0=pure, >0=adulterated; sensitivity=TP/(TP+FN), specificity=TN/(TN+FP); undefined denominators -> null
metrics.volume_mae_pp: Mean absolute difference between predicted and true volume class; not continuous concentration estimation

post_evaluation_refit: After preserving final evaluation and its 414-image model, a separately versioned deployment model may refit the unchanged recipe on all 548 images. It has no untouched test set; never attach the prior score to it as a direct evaluation.

preparation_evaluation.group_rule: One retained image per unit; confirmed same-scene views merged

revision_reason: User confirms images represent individually prepared mixtures; replace missing-preparation assumption while preserving deduplication.
scope: Seven-class by-volume evaluation using user-confirmed individual preparations, with a held-out white Micro capture condition

selection.early_stopping: Use a preregistered fixed epoch schedule; do not use outer validation fold for checkpoint selection
selection.final_fit: Refit locked pipeline on all 414 development images; 134 white Micro holdout images never fitted
selection.primary_metric: mean of three development-fold seven-class macro_f1 values
selection.tie_break: If within 0.005 macro F1, prefer fewer fitted parameters, then shorter measured training time

uncertainty: Report all three fold scores and condition summaries. If bootstrapping final metrics, resample preparation units.
